title: site-docs: changing a machine's models from the portal (Settings > Nodes)
instructions: Write a user-facing page `site-docs/guide/remote-model-control.md` from the section "Changing models from the portal" of docs/install.md (pasted below): a `# Changing models from the portal` title, what it is for (headless hosts, no SSH), the steps in Settings > Nodes, and its limits, in plain words. Keep facts to what the section says. Then add `{ text: "Changing Models from the Portal", link: "/guide/remote-model-control" }` to the Guide sidebar in site-docs/.vitepress/config.ts, right after the Model Management entry.
